text: SIPROTEC 7SA87 is a modular distance protection device for high-voltage lines. It provides essential protection for electrical equipment by detecting and isolating faults with 1-pole or 3-pole tripping capabilities.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7SA87?

text: Electrical systems face challenges from short circuits and ground faults, leading to potential damage and downtime. SIPROTEC 7SA87 detects and selectively trips short circuits and ground faults across various network configurations to maintain system stability. Expect fast fault isolation with a minimum tripping time of 9 ms to minimize damage.
